user.title: DJI Power
user.description: How do you want to sign in?

menu_options.manual_ble: Bluetooth only (enter serial number + pair key manually)

token.title: Sign in to DJI
token.description: Paste your DJI member token (x-member-token). The serial number and Bluetooth key are fetched automatically.

mode.title: Connection mode
mode.description: How should Home Assistant connect to the Power? You can change this later in the options.

manual_ble.title: Bluetooth without token
manual_ble.description: Enter the serial number and the 32-character pair key of your Power.

bluetooth_device.title: Bluetooth device
bluetooth_device.description: Choose the Power with serial number {sn} ({found} found). You can also type an address (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF). Note: only one app can be connected at a time; the DJI app on your phone cannot connect meanwhile.

data_description.keep_token: Needed to switch to cloud later.

discovery_confirm.title: DJI Power found
discovery_confirm.description: A DJI Power ({name}) was found nearby. Set it up?

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The DJI member token for {sn} has expired. Paste a new token.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the DJI cloud.
error.no_devices: No DJI Power found on this account.
error.invalid_pair_key: The pair key must be 32 hexadecimal characters.
error.wrong_account: This account does not contain this device.

abort.not_supported: This is not a supported DJI Power.

init.title: DJI Power options
init.description:
Serial number: {sn} (cannot be changed; add the integration again for another Power).

Member token: {token_state}. Pair key: {key_state}. Leave a field empty to keep the stored value. A new token is verified and refreshes the pair key automatically.

data_description.member_token: Paste a new token here if the old one expired, or to be able to use the cloud.
data_description.pair_key: Normally not needed: the pair key comes from the cloud automatically.

error.no_token: No token is stored; cloud is not available.
error.no_pair_key: No pair key is known; Bluetooth is not available.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the DJI cloud.
error.wrong_account: This account does not contain this device.
error.invalid_pair_key: The pair key must be 32 hexadecimal characters.

list_bound_devices.name: List bound devices
list_bound_devices.description: Fetches the DJI cloud device list (SN, pair_uuid, pair_key) using the member token already stored for this entry. Only available in cloud mode.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The DJI Power to fetch the device list for.
